summary: Stop source-ingest startup from opening one Postgres connection per evidence lookup by reusing connection pool and resolving reloaded references in-memory.

hosted_failure.failure_description: source-ingest-1 startup exceeded ~105s healthcheck grace budget (start_period 5s + 10 retries * 10s), marked unhealthy, blocking 6 core services during docker_compose_up

operator_profile.root_cause: PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository.reload replayed 1108 records through InMemoryEvidenceRepository.add_evidence_item/add_bundle/add_knowledge_object which invoked overridden get_* methods, triggering _read_one and establishing a brand new Postgres connection for every reference lookup

fix.startup_replay: PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository sets _replaying flag during reload(); get_* methods resolve reference validations directly from reloaded in-memory state without Postgres round trips or connection creation
fix.request_time_connection_reuse: PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository maintains a LifoQueue connection pool (autocommit=True) in _get_connection, reusing warm connections for request-time reads and writes while preserving fail-closed sanitized exceptions on failure

before.row_shape: 757 bundles, 117 evidence items, 117 knowledge objects, 117 source records (1108 total)

after.row_shape: 757 bundles, 117 evidence items, 117 knowledge objects, 117 source records (1108 total)

paper_fleet_reconciler_investigation.symptom: GET /api/source-ingest/source-records answered 401 about once per second (667 in 12 minutes)
paper_fleet_reconciler_investigation.mechanism: SourceIngestMarkFetcher._default_fetch_json issues unauthenticated urllib.request to /api/source-ingest/source-records which requires authorization (verify_read_token)
paper_fleet_reconciler_investigation.disposition: Reported as required by acceptance criterion 5; unchanged here as it is an execution service caller issue pre-dating this task

acceptance_verification.ac1_startup_reload_in_memory_references: passed: reload replays stored evidence using in-memory reference lookups; 0 round trips per reference and exactly 1 connection used for 1000 bundles
acceptance_verification.ac2_request_time_connection_reuse: passed: request-time evidence reads reuse pooled connection; cross-process freshness and fail-closed sanitized RuntimeError on DB failure preserved
acceptance_verification.ac3_connection_count_and_startup_budget: passed: reloading 1000 bundles opens at most 1 connection; 757 bundles + 117 items + 117 KOs + 117 sources starts in 0.067s (< 5.0s, well within 105s healthcheck budget)
acceptance_verification.ac4_hosted_failure_and_operator_profile: passed: run 37733353851 and operator profiling recorded with before/after measurements (181s -> 0.067s)
acceptance_verification.ac5_paper_fleet_reconciler_caller_report: passed: caller identified in performance_telemetry.py and documented above
acceptance_verification.ac6_no_compressed_code_and_diff_budget: passed: clean standard code, net prod diff +71 lines <= 80 line budget
acceptance_verification.ac7_hosted_track: recorded as external_wait pending next automatic dev pair release passing docker_compose_up with healthy source-ingest
